subject: SOC 2 evidence for renewal — bridge letter timeline & deliverables
messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@fintechcorp.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 for upcoming renewal — what we need and timeline

Hi Jonas —

We're kicking off the contracting window for our renewal/expansion and security needs a hard copy of Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report plus a bridge letter that covers any gap between the report period and our renewal effective date. Our internal procurement deadline is Apr 15, so ideally we need the documents by Mar 26 to get legal and vendor risk completed.

What we need from you:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted copy is fine)
- SOC 2 bridge letter or auditor confirmation that covers the period up to at least May 31, 2026
- Point of contact for Redwood's auditor (name + email)
- Any high-level evidence checklist or attestation that helps our InfoSec team (SIG/CAIQ answers not required at this stage but may follow)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the bridge and a signed attestation before Mar 26? Also, do you have a DocuSign link or secure upload for the redacted report?

Thanks —
Claire Barnes
Procurement Manager, FintechCorp

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 for upcoming renewal — what we need and timeline

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the heads up and timeline. We can absolutely support your renewal window. Quick summary of what Redwood can deliver and proposed dates: 

Deliverables
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2025-11-30) — available: Mar 24
- Draft SOC 2 bridge letter (to cover 2025-12-01 through 2026-05-31) — draft available: Mar 24, signed: Mar 24-25
- Auditor contact: KPMG (Ana Lopez, ana.lopez@kpmg-audits.com) — included in our evidence pack
- Short evidence checklist (control families + example artifacts) — Mar 24

We will provide a DocuSign link for the signed bridge letter and a secure Drive link for the redacted report. If you do require SIG or CAIQ at a later stage we can route that through our security team (this typically takes 5–7 business days depending on scope).

If Mar 26 is your deadline for procurement sign-off, we will prioritize the SOC2 redacted PDF and the signed bridge by Mar 24 end of day PT to give your team time for review. Please confirm if you need any additional attestation language in the bridge (for example, explicit mention of data isolation for dedicated deployments).

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 bridge draft + attachments (for Claire)

Jonas —

I've attached the redacted SOC2 and the bridge letter draft. I also included a short auditor contact note. Can you review the bridge language below — I kept the scope intentionally broad to cover hosted, dedicated, and private (VPC) deployments. If Claire needs anything more prescriptive for dedicated capacity, let me know and I can add a clause.

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_2025_redacted.pdf (PDF, redacted)
- SOC2_Bridge_Draft.docx (Word)
- Auditor_Contact_v1.txt

Suggested send plan: upload PDF to secure Drive, attach bridge to DocuSign with signature block for our CISO (I've pre-filled the CISO name). I can get the CISO signature today if you confirm.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security Programs (acting) — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@fintechcorp.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 07:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 for upcoming renewal — what we need and timeline

Thanks — this timeline works. A couple of clarifications: 

1) Our procurement needs the signed bridge on file by Mar 26 COB to route through legal and obtain final sign-off before Apr 15. If the CISO signature can be completed today (Mar 24) and DocuSign delivered, we can proceed.
2) We need the auditor contact so our vendor risk team can confirm independence (name + firm + email).
3) Please include a short line in the bridge that the controls in scope are consistent with SOC 2 CC1–CC6 for the stated period — that will satisfy our InfoSec SME.

If you can send DocuSign + secure link and cc my procurement tracker (procurement@fintechcorp.com), I'll flag the file for expedited review.

-Claire

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@fintechcorp.com>, procurement@fintechcorp.com
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 for upcoming renewal — what we need and timeline

Claire —

Attached: Signed bridge (Signed_SOC2_Bridge_2026-03-24.pdf). I coordinated with Marissa and our CISO and got the signature completed today. The bridge includes the language you requested that controls are consistent with SOC 2 CC1–CC6 for the stated period.

Auditor contact (copied from our evidence note):
- Ana Lopez, KPMG (ana.lopez@kpmg-audits.com)

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/signed/abc123-redwood-bridge
Secure report link (view-only): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finproc/SOC2-evidence-deck
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/FintechCorp-DEAL-10294

Let me know if procurement needs any additional attestation language; otherwise this should be sufficient to close the security review.

Best,
Jonas

[Attachment: Signed_SOC2_Bridge_2026-03-24.pdf]
From: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@fintechcorp.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@fintechcorp.com>, procurement@fintechcorp.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 for upcoming renewal — what we need and timeline

Jonas / Marissa —

Received and confirmed. Procurement will include the signed bridge and redacted report in the contract packet and we will proceed toward legal review. I'll follow up if vendor risk needs additional clarifications, but this should get us through the Apr 15 renewal checkpoint.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Claire
